notes: Both assigned records have identical references, empty locators, null descriptions and null study identifiers. No effect-to-claim mapping can be established independently; input order and audit IDs were not used to assign claims. The replication report contains different author verdicts for different claims, so an effect-specific narrative verdict cannot be assigned. No statistics were selected or calculated. The original source is an earlier working-paper version, not the final 2017 article; its title and four authors match. DOI landing page returned HTTP 403 and the EconStor alternative served a bot challenge; neither was retried. CEPII supplied full paper text. OSF file metadata identified the assigned DOCX and its full text was acquired. Neither paper is classified as unavailable.
